prompt: Over the last six months our monthly average BOD exceeded the permit limit by about 25% in three of those months, and was fine in the other three. Is the facility in significant noncompliance? Walk me through the criteria.
assertions: Classifies BOD as a Group I pollutant with a technical review criterion of 1.4x the limit (40% over)
Concludes 25% over does not meet the TRC
Explains the chronic criterion needs exceedance in 4 or more of 6 months and that 3 months does not meet it
Concludes the data does not meet the effluent SNC criteria
Caveats that reporting violations (e.g. late/missing DMRs) can independently cause SNC and that EPA/the state assigns SNC status
